channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Healthy Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified healthy food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: El Pollo Loco: $5 Fire-Grilled Combos: Rotating Value Menu
item.guid: El Pollo Loco-$5 Fire-Grilled Combos: Rotating Value M-2026-10-03
item.description: A rotating lineup of roughly $5 combos (Original Pollo Bowl, Classic Chicken Burrito, taquitos and more) built on citrus-marinated fire-grilled chicken, every day at participating locations. Lineup and pricing vary by market. (West & Southwest only) (Ongoing)

item.title: H-E-B: $7 Saturday: Select Sushiya Rolls for $7
item.guid: H-E-B-$7 Saturday: Select Sushiya Rolls for $7-2026-10-03
item.description: H-E-B's Sushiya counters repeat the $7 select-roll price on Saturdays at participating Texas stores. No coupon or app needed; selection varies by store. (Texas only) (Saturdays only)

item.title: Publix: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
item.guid: Publix-Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's -2026-10-03
item.description: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it. (FL & Southeast only) (Ongoing (changes weekly))

item.title: Salad and Go: Salads and wraps from $7.75
item.guid: Salad and Go-Salads and wraps from $7.75-2026-10-03
item.description: Drive-thru-only salads and wraps, including the Good Greens Salad and Wrap with chickpeas, Brussels sprouts and a choice of chicken or tofu, start at $7.75 every day. (AZ, TX, OK & NV only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Rubio's Coastal Grill: $7+ Meal Menu, including Fish & Chips for $7.99
item.guid: Rubio's Coastal Grill-$7+ Meal Menu, including Fish & Chip-2026-10-03
item.description: Rubio's standing value menu runs meals from $7 to $10, headlined by Fish & Chips for $7.99, every day at participating locations. (CA, AZ & NV only) (Ongoing)

item.title: WaBa Grill: Value-Bowl Combo: mini bowl, side and drink for $7.99
item.guid: WaBa Grill-Value-Bowl Combo: mini bowl, side and dr-2026-10-03
item.description: A permanent value item: a mini bowl with chicken, sweet and spicy chicken or tofu, plus a value side and a 12 oz drink for $7.99, every day at participating locations. (CA & AZ only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Naf Naf Grill: $9.99 Pita Meal Deal
item.guid: Naf Naf Grill-$9.99 Pita Meal Deal-2026-10-03
item.description: Naf Naf Grill's value menu: a full pita meal for $9.99, in store and in the app, every day at participating locations. (Midwest & East only) (Ongoing)
